recognize_zh: 淋巴結低倍可見被膜明顯纖維化增厚；高倍有大量漿細胞浸潤，並環繞血管形成同心圓狀袖套，血管壁增厚、管腔狹窄（閉塞性動脈炎樣）；梅毒螺旋體免疫染色見大量紅色螺旋狀菌體，符合梅毒性淋巴結炎。
features: Panel A: matted lymph node with thick fibrotic capsule and surrounding dense fibrosis
Panel B: dense plasma cell-rich infiltrate with admixed histiocytes in fibrous stroma
Panel C: small vessel with thickened wall and narrowed lumen surrounded by concentric perivascular plasma cell cuffing
Panel D: Treponema pallidum IHC shows numerous red-staining organisms concentrated in perivascular areas
Panel D inset: organisms have thin spiral (corkscrew) morphology
describe_en: Composite figure. Lymph node biopsy shows matted nodal tissue with marked capsular and pericapsular fibrosis. At higher power there is a dense plasma cell-rich infiltrate with histiocytes, and small vessels show endothelial swelling, mural thickening and concentric perivascular cuffing by plasma cells, in keeping with obliterative vasculitis. Treponema pallidum immunohistochemistry highlights numerous spiral organisms distributed in aggregates and around vessels. Findings are consistent with syphilitic lymphadenitis; serologic confirmation is recommended.

ddx.vs: IgG4-related disease shows plasma cell-rich fibrosis with increased IgG4+ cells and obliterative phlebitis but no treponemes on T. pallidum IHC.
Castleman disease shows interfollicular sheets of plasma cells with regressed follicles and no spirochetes or obliterative arteritis.
These show well-formed granulomas with necrosis and organisms on AFB or GMS stains, which were negative here.
Neoplastic plasma cells show light-chain restriction on kappa/lambda ISH, whereas syphilitic plasma cells are polytypic.
